Elements: **b**, **strong**, *i*, *em*, ++u++, ~~s~~, ~~del~~, ==mark== and `code`.

Styles: **bold**, *italic*, ~~struck~~, ++underlined++, `mono`, X^2^ and X~2~.

Highlights: ==a==, ==b==, ==c== and ==d==.

Not formatting: normal weight and normal style.

Kept as HTML: red, Arial and spaced.

Nested: **bold and *bold italic***, **++bold underlined++**.

A link with a superscript: [m<sup>2</sup>](https://example.com/area).
